deviations.scope_text: Model, optimizer, input, and target construction are excluded from step latency.
deviations.observed_execution: The timed stage.loss creates a one-element constant target with torch.full_like before evaluating MSE.
deviations.impact_assessment: The same scalar target construction is included in all arms. It is not model-size or edge-count dependent, but it is a real protocol mismatch.
deviations.disposition: Retain both raw grids without alteration, disclose the mismatch, and require a preconstructed target in a future benchmark revision.
